limitations: The published occultation fit uses this same 574-vertex, 1144-facet dimensionless model, refining its uniform size, pole and period. visibleDescription: Convex light-curve model fitted to a stellar occultation: 118.8 ± 0.6 km volume-equivalent diameter. Grid marks unavailable imagery; rotational phase is illustrative.
